acceptanceCriteria: Production root is constructed once and reachable from Android and iOS entry points.
Android and iOS build contracts are explicit; no secrets are embedded.
Detekt is strict and Kover is filtered with baseline measurement deferred until meaningful tests exist.
ComposablePreviewScanner/Paparazzi is hosted in the Compose resource module and can discover a nonzero production preview.
CI includes Linux Android/quality checks and macOS iOS compilation/test/linkage checks.
All changes stay within the registered assignment boundary and an immutable Protocol 2.0 handoff is produced.
goal: Establish the KMP Android/iOS production foundation, explicit composition/root lifecycle, strict Detekt and filtered Kover wiring, Compose preview scanner/Paparazzi smoke host, and Android/iOS build-test CI contracts. Do not implement feature business rules or final UI.
requestedCommands: preview scanner and Paparazzi smoke record/verify
